label: Text 1
transcript: The class read three chapters of The Slow Lane by an imagined contemporary author — a short novel about a teenage long-distance runner. By chapter three, half the class had stopped seeing it as a sports book. Maja underlined the line running, like reading, is a way of staying still while you move. She showed the line to nobody for a week.

label: Text 2
transcript: Running, like reading, is a way of staying still while you move. By the third week of training, I had discovered something I hadn't expected: the slow kilometres were the ones doing the work. Whereas the fast intervals felt like proof, the slow lanes felt like the actual training. Moreover, I learned that everyone faster than me said the same thing.
